summary: The KayKit large barrel matches the brief: bulging reddish-brown staves, two dark iron hoops, a lid with a bung. It is well within budget, every assertion passes, and none of its open loops shows in any view.

findings.observation: The hoops are mid-to-dark grey (corrected median #6B6560, grouped under Wet Slate), not near-black Blackened Iron; they still read as dark iron against the staves.

questions_answered: All prompt elements present, plus a lid bung that fits a barrel.
4 parts; 5 open loops (hoop band edges, bung underside), none visible; no spikes or fragments.
Yes: Barrow Oak 10.2 -> 0.8, Wet Slate 12.3 -> 2.7; hoops read grey rather than near-black (minor).
